```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(car)
library(FSA)
library(writexl)
library(SIBER)

```

# Load SIA Data
```{r sia_df}
sia <- read_xlsx("data/SIA/Stable_Isotope_Data.xlsx") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID:CN_ratio)

sia$`%N` <- as.numeric(sia$`%N`)

sia_df <- sia %>%
  mutate(
    Depth = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "Deep") ~ "Deep",
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "Midd") ~ "Middle",
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "Shall") ~ "Shallow",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "Host") ~ "Host",
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "Zoox") ~ "Zoox",
      str_detect(Sample_ID, "water") ~ "Water",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Replicate = if_else(str_detect(Sample_ID, "_r2$|R2$"), "R2", "R1")
  ) 
```

# Compare Replicates
```{r R1 and R2 dfs}
#Separate R1 and R2 to get separate columns and then combine 
R1 <- sia_df %>%
  filter(Replicate == "R1") %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Type, Depth, R1_d15N = d15N, R1_d13C = d13C, R1_CN_ratio = CN_ratio) %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "_Host"),
         Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "_Zoox"))

R2 <- sia_df %>%
  filter(Replicate == "R2") %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "_Host_r2"),
         Sample_ID = str_remove(Sample_ID, "_Zoox_r2")) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Type, Depth, R2_d15N = d15N, R2_d13C = d13C, R2_CN_ratio = CN_ratio)

rep_comp <- left_join(R1, R2) %>%
  filter(Type != "Water")

```

```{r visualize R1 vs R2 for each sample}

ggplot(rep_comp %>% filter(Depth == "Shallow"), aes(x = R1_d13C, y = R2_d13C, shape = Type, color = Sample_ID)) +
```

```{r standard deviation between samples}
rep_comp_sd <- rep_comp %>%
  mutate(
    sd_d13C = apply(select(., R1_d13C, R2_d13C), 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_d15N = apply(select(., R1_d15N, R2_d15N), 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_CN_ratio = apply(select(., R1_CN_ratio, R2_CN_ratio), 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(sd_d13C < 1,
         sd_CN_ratio < 1)
  
rep_comp_sd_sum <- rep_comp_sd %>%
  group_by(Type, Depth) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_sd_d13C = mean(sd_d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sd_d15N = mean(sd_d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sd_CN_ratio = mean(sd_CN_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Visualize SD between samples for each group 
# d13C
rep_comp %>%
  mutate(sd_d13C = apply(select(., R1_d13C, R2_d13C), 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Depth, y = sd_d13C, fill = Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(y = "Within-sample SD of δ13C", title = "Analytical precision by Depth and Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# d15N
rep_comp %>%
  mutate(sd_d15N = apply(select(., R1_d15N, R2_d15N), 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Depth, y = sd_d15N, fill = Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(y = "Within-sample SD of δ15N", title = "Analytical precision by Depth and Type") +
  theme_minimal()

# Mean diff R1-R2
rep_comp %>%
  mutate(
    diff_d13C = abs(R1_d13C - R2_d13C),
    diff_d15N = abs(R1_d15N - R2_d15N)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Type, Depth) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_diff_d13C = mean(diff_d13C, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_d15N = mean(diff_d15N, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

# Host vs Zoox Carbon (Filtered)
```{r sia_df_combo}
sia_df_combo <-  sia_df_means %>% 
  mutate(Depth_Geno = substring(Sample_ID, first = 13)) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Depth, Depth_Geno, Type, mean_d13C, mean_d15N, mean_CN_ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Sample_ID, Depth),
    names_from = Type,
    values_from = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_sep = "_")

ggplot(sia_df_combo, aes(x = mean_d13C_Host, y = mean_d13C_Zoox, color = Depth)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#00004C", "#11569B", "#56A9DC")) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") 

```

# CN Stats on all means (Filtered)
```{r sia_df_host & sia_df_zoox} 
# Host C:N 
sia_df_host <- sia_df_means %>%
  filter(Type == "Host")

# Homogeneity of Variances 
leveneTest(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_host) # no sig diff: p = 0.51

aov_host <- aov(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_host) # sig diff: p = 0.003
summary(aov_host)

TukeyHSD(aov_host)

#_______________________________________________________________________________#

# Zoox C:N
sia_df_zoox <- sia_df_means %>%
  filter(Type == "Zoox")

# Homogeneity of Variances 
leveneTest(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_zoox) # sig diff p = 0.04

# Kruskal Test
kruskal.test(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_zoox) # no sig diff p = 0.5

# Welch Anova
oneway.test(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_zoox, var.equal = FALSE)


```

# Holobiont means (filtered)
```{r holo_means}
holo_means <- rep_comp_sd %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Sample_ID, Depth),
    names_from = Type,
    values_from = c(
      R1_d15N, R1_d13C, R1_CN_ratio,
      R2_d15N, R2_d13C, R2_CN_ratio),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Type}") %>%
  mutate(mean_d13C = (R1_d13C_Host + R2_d13C_Host + R1_d13C_Zoox + R2_d13C_Zoox)/4) %>%
  mutate(mean_d15N = (R1_d15N_Host + R2_d15N_Host + R1_d15N_Zoox + R2_d15N_Zoox)/4) %>%
  mutate(mean_CN = (R1_CN_ratio_Host + R2_CN_ratio_Host + R1_CN_ratio_Zoox + R1_CN_ratio_Zoox)/4) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, Depth, mean_d13C, mean_d15N, mean_CN)


ggplot(holo_means, aes(x = mean_d13C, y = mean_d15N, color = Depth, shape = Depth)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Depth), size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
 
# Ellipse for Host (solid)
  stat_ellipse(data = holo_means, aes(group = Depth),
    type = "t", size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#00004C", "#11569B", "#56A9DC"))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  ggtitle("Holobiont SIA")

```

# C:N Stats Comparison on filtered data
```{r}
# Host C:N 
sia_df_clean_host <- sia_df_clean %>%
  filter(Type == "Host")

# Homogeneity of Variances 
leveneTest(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_clean_host) #sig diff: p = 0.04

# Kruskal Test
kruskal.test(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_clean_host) #sig diff p = 0.01

# Dunn Test 
dunnTest(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_clean_host, method = "bh")

#_____________________________________________________________________________#
# Zoox
sia_df_clean_zoox <- sia_df_clean %>%
  filter(Type == "Zoox")

# levene test 
leveneTest(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_clean_zoox) # not sig

# Anvoa for Zoox
zoox_anova <- aov(mean_CN_ratio ~ Depth, data = sia_df_clean_zoox)

summary(zoox_anova) # not sig effect of depth on C:N
```

# Comparing SIA to depth (filtered)
```{r}
sample_data <- read_xlsx(path = "data/frag_data/2023-AS_NMS_Mgris_collections.xlsx") %>%
  select(Sample_ID = Frag_ID, Depth_Group, Colony_Depth_m) %>%
  filter(!(Sample_ID %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4")))

sia_df_depths <- left_join(sia_df_means, sample_data, by = "Sample_ID")

# Function to calculate standard error
standard_error <- function(x) {
  sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
}

sia_df_means_summary <- sia_df_depths %>%
  group_by(Depth, Type) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_d13C = mean(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    se_d13C = standard_error(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    mean_d15N = mean(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N)),
    se_d15N = standard_error(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N)),
    mean_Colony_Depth = mean(Colony_Depth_m))

ggplot(sia_df_means_summary, aes(x = mean_Colony_Depth, y = mean_d13C, color = Type)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_d13C - se_d13C, ymax = mean_d13C + se_d13C), width = 0.2) +
  ggtitle("Filtered for SD > 1 between replicates")
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Mean Colony Depth", y = "Mean d13C", color = "Depth", shape = "Type")
  
```

# # Comparing SIA to depth (unfiltered)
```{r}
sia_df_depths_unfiltered <- left_join(rep_comp, sample_data, by = "Sample_ID")

sia_df_depths_unfiltered_summary <- sia_df_depths_unfiltered %>%
  group_by(Depth, Type) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_d13C = mean(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    se_d13C = standard_error(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    mean_d15N = mean(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N)),
    se_d15N = standard_error(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N)),
    mean_Colony_Depth = mean(Colony_Depth_m))

ggplot(sia_df_depths_unfiltered_summary, aes(x = mean_Colony_Depth, y = mean_d13C, color = Type)) +
  geom_point() +
   geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_d13C - se_d13C, ymax = mean_d13C + se_d13C), width = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Mean Colony Depth", y = "Mean d13C", color = "Depth", shape = "Type")

sia_df_depths_means_unfiltered <- sia_df_depths_unfiltered %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Type) %>%
  mutate(mean_d13C = mean(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    se_d13C = standard_error(c(R1_d13C, R2_d13C)),
    mean_d15N = mean(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N)),
    se_d15N = standard_error(c(R1_d15N, R2_d15N))) %>%
  ungroup() 


ggplot(sia_df_depths_means_unfiltered, aes(x = Colony_Depth_m, y = mean_d13C, color = Type)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm)

```

# SIBER Analysis (Filtered)
```{r}
# Deep 
siber_df_deep <- sia_df_means %>%
  filter(Depth == "Deep") %>%
  select(iso1 = mean_d13C, iso2= mean_d15N, group = Type,
         community = Depth)

siber_df_deep <- as.data.frame(siber_df_deep)

siber_object_deep <- createSiberObject(siber_df_deep)

siber_object_deep_plot <- siber_object_deep$raw.data$Deep


ggplot(siber_object_deep_plot, aes(x = iso1, y = iso2, color = group, fill = group)) +
  
  stat_ellipse(
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.2,
    level = 0.40) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Host" = "pink2",
                                "Zoox" = "darkgreen")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Host" = "pink2",
                               "Zoox" = "darkgreen")) +
  
  labs(
    x = expression(delta^13*C~"\u2030"),
    y = expression(delta^15*N~"\u2030")
  ) +
  
  theme_classic()
```
